newsitem.title: USA: Jabil Circuit sees Q3 gain from tax break.
newsitem.headline: Jabil Circuit sees Q3 gain from tax break.

text.p: Jabil Circuit Inc said on Monday that it will report a gain of $712,000, or $0.04 a share, for the third quarter ending May 1997 for a tax benefit that the company's Malaysian subsidiary is receiving.
The company's Penang, Malaysia subsidiary has been granted "pioneer" tax status for a five year period commencing Nov. 1, 1995.
This status allows tax free treatment for the subsidiary's income through Oct. 30, 2000, it said. Malaysia's statutory income tax rate is 30 percent, Jabil said.

The company indicated that its normalized 35.5 percent tax rate (experienced in quarters where all factories achieve targeted operating goals) will be reduced to approximately 34.5 percent for future periods as a result of this change.
Future tax rates will fluctuate with changes in profitability by region, the company said.
